responsibility: This header defines the `neoversev2_tunings` model for Arm Neoverse V2 in the AArch64 backend. It introduces V2-specific register-move costs, AdvSIMD and SVE vector cost tables, issue-resource descriptions, issue rate, reassociation widths, and Armv9 tune flags, forming the per-core `tune_params` bundle that distinguishes Neoverse V2 scheduling and costing behavior from the V1 and N2 profiles.
